enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down in bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns to side. Remains still. Breathes slowly. Wakes briefly, opens eyes, turns over, closes eyes. Sleeps. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up in bed. Pushes blanket aside. Swings legs to floor. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Picks up soap. Washes face. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Picks up clothes. Puts on clothes. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing breakfast for the household, boiling water in the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread, eggs, butter. Closes refrigerator. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever down. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Turns on kettle. Takes out frying pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into bowl. Beats eggs with fork. Pours eggs into pan. Stirs eggs. Takes out plates. Places plates on counter. Takes out cutlery. Sets table. Checks toaster. Removes toast. Places toast on plate. Turns off stove. Turns off kettle. Pours hot water into cups. Calls out 'Breakfast is ready!' to Member 2. Waits for Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast with Member 2 (Member 2 eats 07:00-07:30), then tidying the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Sits down at table. Says 'Good morning' to Member 2. Picks up fork. Eats eggs. Picks up toast. Takes bite. Drinks water. Continues eating. Member 2 finishes eating at 07:30 and leaves. Says 'See you later' to Member 2. Finishes eating. Stands up. Picks up plates. Scrapes food into bin. Places plates in sink. Wipes counter with cloth. Rinses cloth. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth to dry.

enriched_activities.activity: Sweeping and vacuuming the living room floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Turns on living room light. Picks up broom from closet. Sweeps floor. Moves furniture to sweep underneath. Sweeps dirt into dustpan. Empties dustpan into bin. Puts broom away. Picks up vacuum cleaner. Plugs in vacuum cleaner. Turns on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Moves vacuum around furniture. Turns off vacuum. Unplugs vacuum. Wraps cord. Puts vacuum away. Turns off living room light.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine, washing clothes and hanging them to dry
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Opens washing machine. Picks up dirty clothes. Places clothes into washing machine. Adds detergent. Closes washing machine door. Presses start button. Waits for wash cycle. When done, opens washing machine. Takes out wet clothes. Picks up clothes basket. Places clothes in basket. Carries basket to drying area. Picks up clothes one by one. Shakes out each item. Hangs clothes on drying rack. Uses clothespins. Finishes hanging. Turns off bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the local market and grocery shopping for fresh vegetables and household supplies
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on shoes. Picks up shopping bag. Opens door. Walks out. Closes door. Walks along street. Reaches market. Picks up basket. Selects vegetables: tomatoes, lettuce, carrots. Places vegetables in basket. Weighs vegetables at scale. Picks up household supplies: soap, detergent. Places in basket. Goes to checkout. Pays cashier. Receives change. Puts items in shopping bag. Walks back home. Opens door. Enters home. Closes door.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting away groceries and washing and chopping vegetables for lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Places shopping bag on counter. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Places vegetables in refrigerator. Takes out household supplies. Places supplies in cupboard. Closes refrigerator. Takes vegetables out of refrigerator. Places vegetables in sink. Turns on tap. Washes vegetables. Turns off tap. Places vegetables on cutting board. Picks up knife. Chops vegetables. Places chopped vegetables in bowl. Washes knife. Dries knife. Puts knife away.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking lunch on the induction cooker and steaming rice in the rice cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on rice cooker. Measures rice. Washes rice. Adds water. Places inner pot in rice cooker. Closes lid. Presses cook button. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on induction cooker. Pours oil. Adds chopped vegetables. Stirs vegetables. Adds spices. Stirs. Covers pan. Waits. Checks rice cooker. Turns off induction cooker. Turns off rice cooker. Lets rice steam.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch and clearing the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Serves rice. Serves vegetables. Picks up fork. Eats. Drinks water. Finishes meal. Stands up. Picks up plate. Scrapes leftovers into bin. Places plate in sink. Picks up glass. Places glass in sink. Turns on tap. Rinses dishes. Turns off tap. Places dishes in drying rack. Wipes table with cloth. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and taking an afternoon nap
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over. Closes eyes. Turns to side. Sleeps. Wakes briefly. Turns over. Sleeps again. Opens eyes. Sits up. Stretches. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Dusting furniture, folding laundry and tidying the shared living space
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Picks up dust cloth. Wipes dust from TV stand. Wipes coffee table. Wipes shelves. Shakes cloth. Puts cloth away. Picks up laundry basket. Takes out dried clothes. Folds shirts. Folds pants. Stacks folded clothes. Places clothes in basket. Carries basket to bedrooms. Puts clothes in drawers. Returns to living room. Arranges cushions on sofa. Straightens magazines. Picks up trash. Throws trash in bin.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at the desk with the lamp on, checking the phone and making calls to organise household matters
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Sits at desk. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Scrolls through messages. Opens contacts. Selects a contact. Places phone to ear. Speaks: 'Hello, this is Member 3. I need to confirm the delivery.' Listens. Says: 'Thank you. Goodbye.' Ends call. Picks up pen. Writes note on pad. Puts pen down. Checks phone again. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and cooking dinner, using the oven and range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out meat and vegetables. Closes refrigerator. Places meat on cutting board. Cuts meat. Places meat in baking dish. Adds seasoning. Turns on oven. Turns on range hood. Places baking dish in oven. Sets timer. Turns on stove. Places pot on stove. Adds water. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Covers pot. Waits.

enriched_activities.activity: Finishing dinner preparation and setting the table
enriched_activities.desc: Checks oven. Turns off oven. Takes out baking dish. Places baking dish on counter. Turns off stove. Takes out plates. Places plates on table. Takes out cutlery. Places cutlery on table. Takes out glasses. Places glasses on table. Fills water pitcher. Places pitcher on table. Adjusts chair. Calls out 'Dinner is ready!' to Member 2. Waits.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with Member 2, aligned with Member 2's dinner time
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Says 'Let's eat' to Member 2. Serves food. Picks up fork. Eats. Drinks water. Talks with Member 2 about day. Continues eating. Finishes meal. Stands up. Picks up plate. Places plate in sink. Picks up glass. Places glass in sink. Wipes table. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the counters and stove
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on tap. Picks up sponge. Applies soap. Washes plates. Rinses plates. Places plates in drying rack. Washes glasses. Rinses glasses. Places glasses in drying rack. Washes cutlery. Rinses cutlery. Places cutlery in drying rack. Turns off tap. Picks up cloth. Wipes counters. Wipes stove. Rinses cloth. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth. Turns off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching television and relaxing on the sofa with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Turns on TV. Picks up remote. Sits on sofa. Changes channels. Settles on program. Watches TV. Talks with Member 2. Laughs. Gets up to get snack. Picks up glass of water. Drinks. Puts glass down. Adjusts cushion. Continues watching. Turns off TV at 21:00. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Washes hair. Rinses off. Turns off water. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Puts on pajamas. Turns off water heater. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and using the phone under the desk lamp with the fan running
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on fan. Sits at desk. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns page. Puts book down. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Scrolls through news. Checks messages. Replies to message. Puts phone down. Picks up book again. Reads. Closes book. Turns off desk lamp. Turns off fan. Lies down in bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down in bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns over. Continues sleeping. Wakes briefly. Adjusts pillow. Sleeps. Remains still.
